title: The Last Keeper of the Lighthouse
explanation: For years the lighthouse burned the same light — until one night it went out on its own.

title: The Silent Song of the North
explanation: Ravi follows a song he has never heard to a city whose name he does not know.

title: The Glass Garden
explanation: Behind Bahar's clock shop lies a garden no one knows of — made of glass and of time.

title: Forgotten Letters
explanation: A chest full of letters becomes an invisible thread binding two strangers together.
